description: Enterprise. Routes an oversize or heavy truck load to a Texas site and flags what is on the way, from federal and state public data. Origin defaults to the nearest port; or pass origin as nearest_intermodal, nearest_transload, or an origin address or coordinate (a town the load ships from). The route is a truck route on OpenStreetMap (Valhalla) that honors mapped height, width and weight limits for the load given. Along it: FHWA National Bridge Inventory bridges within 25 m that are posted, restricted or closed, have clearance under the load height plus 1 ft, or have an operating rating under the load weight; TxGIO low-water crossings within 50 m (inventory about 2010); and, on the last miles to the site, local roads, minor collectors and lanes under 11 ft from FHWA HPMS 2024. No permit, escort or cost figures: TxDMV routes every oversize or overweight permit, and a heavy-haul carrier confirms the route.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

include_geometry.description: Return the route line as GeoJSON (route_geojson) for drawing on a map.

last_mi.description: Miles at the site end to list minor roads for. Default 5, max 20.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

origin.description: nearest_port (default), nearest_intermodal, nearest_transload, or an address or town the load ships from.

origin_lat.description: Origin latitude (with origin_lng) instead of origin.

via.description: Optional through points to force the route, as lat,lng pairs separated by semicolons (up to 8), e.g. to go around a flagged bridge.

weight_tons.description: Gross load weight in US tons (truck, trailer and load). Default 80 (a typical overweight lowboy).

name: heavy_haul
title: Heavy haul check: truck route from a port or terminal to a site
